hero.headline: Run your salon. Effortlessly.
hero.subhead: Certxa brings online booking, a salon POS, client management, waitlist, staff payroll, and review tools into one platform — built for nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, massage studios, hair removal studios, and braid and weave salons.
hero.socialProof: Free Solo plan · 60-day trial on team plans

features.title: Your business's own booking webpage.
features.description: Every business on Certxa gets a dedicated booking page clients can visit anytime — from your website, a direct link, Google, or Instagram. They pick their service, provider, and time. Automated reminders cut no-shows before they happen.

features.title: A register built for beauty businesses.
features.description: A touch-screen front desk that handles tickets, services, add-ons, tips, split payments, gift cards, and cash — all in one place. Syncs to every client record automatically. Works across multiple stations and keeps running even when the internet goes down.

features.title: Clients check themselves in.
features.description: A tablet at the front door lets clients check in with their phone number or a QR code, pick their service, and join the queue — no staff needed. Recognizes returning clients and suggests what they are due for. Available in English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean.

features.title: Never lose a walk-in again.
features.description: When your business is fully booked, Certxa captures walk-ins on a live digital waitlist. The moment a slot opens, the next client is automatically notified and given a one-tap confirmation window — so you fill cancellations instantly without any manual follow-up.

features.title: Fair turns, automatically.
features.description: Certxa assigns walk-ins to staff members based on rules you set. The turn board shows who is next, who is with a client, and who is on a break — keeping things fair and transparent for the whole team without any manual tracking.

features.title: Two ways to keep clients coming back.
features.description: Choose the loyalty program that fits your business. The digital punch card awards one punch per visit — once a client hits the number you set, a reward is automatically applied at checkout. Or run a points program where clients earn points per dollar spent, redeemable for discounts you define.

features.title: Your receptionist, available 24/7.
features.description: Autumn answers every call — in under 2 seconds, around the clock. She books new appointments, handles rescheduling and cancellations, answers questions about services and pricing, and upsells add-ons. While your salon is open she sees your live board, so callers get a real wait time, not a guess. After hours she keeps booking without implying anyone is in the building.

benefits.text: Answers every call in under 2 seconds
Books, reschedules, and cancels in real time
Knows live wait times and staff availability
After-hours booking — never misses a call

features.title: More five-star reviews, on autopilot.
features.description: After every visit, Certxa automatically texts the client asking for a review. Happy clients are sent straight to your Google review page. Unhappy clients can reach you privately first — so you fix problems before they go public.

pricing.name: Solo
pricing.description: Free for one independent professional: online booking, POS, kiosk and 20 Autumn calls a month.

pricing.name: Professional
pricing.description: Unlimited staff and calendars, payroll, review requests and 50 Autumn calls a month.

pricing.name: Elite
pricing.description: Up to 5 locations, multi-location reporting, API access and 100 Autumn calls a month.

cta.subhead: Use Certxa to fill your books, reduce no-shows, and grow revenue — without the admin.
